reviewer: Codex, curriculum and design work authorized by George
factChecks: Read the full connected EYNTK Biology note. It is a short, informal summary, not the full 510-page book named in its metadata. The note's claim that cells divide because they are about to die is corrected. Its unrelated claims about taxonomy, reproduction and immunity are not imported as facts.

Checked standard concepts against eighteen exact OpenStax Biology 2e sections, including cells, passive transport, enzymes, energy transfer, DNA, division, inheritance, evolution and ecology. The current web licence is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Sources are reference-only; all Discere prose, datasets, problems and artwork are original.

Independently reviewed all 176 responses: 96 lesson questions, 32 recall cards and 48 course-check items. Recomputed 81 numeric keys (41 lesson, 16 recall and 24 check); reviewed the remaining 95 term and choice authorities. Every choice has one markable option. Curriculum and writing validation reports no issues.

Fourteen model tests check diffusion and osmotic conservation across all 324 bounded solute pairs, equilibrium, complementary bases, independent gamete pairings, chromosome versus DNA counts, energy-transfer fractions and strict schema rejection. Osmosis uses a movable partition with no pressure difference; it is not a fixed-volume cell-pressure simulation.

Eight renderer tests verify concealed summaries, osmosis labels and reset, aligned DNA construction, shared chart scales, selected cell structures, carbon tracing and read-only assessment givens. Chromosome pair lengths distinguish homologues, and screen-reader descriptions expose the same visible state.

Added explicit equivalent terms for a single canonical answer idea. Three assessment-engine tests verify alternatives, word boundaries, negation, conflicting rejected terms and unchanged multi-idea coverage behavior. Existing authorities gain no new default fields, preserving their publication hashes.

Five staged browser scenarios pass on disposable databases. All 64 teaching beats and both cases work at 1440x900, 1024x768 and 390x844. Answer fields and choices are reachable above the fixed footer; keyboard controls, reset and reduced-motion settings work.

Browser checks cover explanations after mistakes, earned green feedback, fresh typed recall, saved completion, all 48 check responses, hidden marking until submission, complete lesson prerequisites and a real seven-day delayed transfer requirement. Learner journey payloads omit answer authorities, accepted terms and alternatives.

Inspected original cover, course roadmap, cell, membrane, enzyme, DNA, meiosis, Punnett, population, food-web, trophic-energy, experiment, assessment and feedback captures. Fixed crowded osmotic labels and compacted term-answer fields on tablets. Final corrected captures were inspected.

Illustrative data are labelled as such. Mendelian crosses assume one locus and complete dominance; offspring probabilities are not fixed quotas. Chromosome diagrams show one allocation without crossover. Trophic efficiencies are explicit assumptions, not a universal ten-percent rule. Overall reaction accounting makes no fixed ATP-yield claim.

This is an authoring-agent review under George's delegated course and design authority. It is not independent human subject review or measured learner-outcome evidence. Genetics, ecology, evolution and wider biology remain partial, with substantial molecular, organismal, field and quantitative work outstanding.
